text:
nora: opening PR to clarify HorizonXL long-context behavior + add a short benchmark table and SDK v3/v4 snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822

felix: quick ask 1: are we documenting the exact sequence length ceiling vs the recommended soft-limit? customers get confused when models accept >8k tokens but latency/ooms happen.

nora: good point. plan: add two rows hard cap and recommended operating range plus a short note about preferring prefix caching for long continuations.

ying: bench numbers I ran on rtx-a6000 (batch=1, horizon-xl-quant):
- 2048: 95ms
- 4096: 210ms
- 8192: 980ms (OOMs observed without cache)
I uploaded CSV: https://drive.google.com/horizon-xl-longctx.csv

marta: for the SDK snippets, please include both v3 and v4 examples and call out renamed params: v3 used `cache_window`, v4 uses `max_cache_tokens`. small code blocks are best.

felix: also call out compatibility with adapter variants: some low-bit adapters disable chunked attention kernels which impacts long-context throughput. one-liner under Compatibility is enough.

nora: draft snippet for v4 (js):
```js
const res = await client.generate({
  model: "horizon-xl-quant",
  input: longDoc,
  max_cache_tokens: 8192,
  streaming: false, // streaming may be slower on some quant variants
});
```

ying: tiny nit: prefer `max_cache_tokens: 4096` example in docs as the conservative default; mention 8192 only as an experimental upper bound.

marta: i'm going to add a tiny two-column table: "recommended" vs "tradeoff" and paste the CSV median latency numbers. also will update the embed truncation example (it used `truncate` previously) to `truncate_front` per SDK conventions.

docbot: docs-lint: failed \u001f8b2 - missing bench CSV link update to /benchmarks/long-context/horizon-xl.

nora: thanks bot. updating links and switching the CLI example to the v3 SDK example + v4 snippet. will push in a minute.

felix: one more thought  add a short migration note for Dedicated customers: how to pin a non-quant variant via the admin variants API while they test cache settings. a curl example is helpful.

ying: added a short reproducibility snippet (python) for the bench so SEs can re-run quickly.

marta: pushed text + table + both snippets. preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4822/

docbot: docs-lint: passed ✅ preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4822/ (staging)

nora: thanks all. i'll merge after CI. follow-up: create a follow-up issue to add automated long-context regression checks to the benchmark suite.

felix: +1

ying: +1

marta: +1

nora: merging once green. :tada:
